label: Tire Curing Press TCP-01 - SIMULATION
info:
Tire curing press TCP-01 simulation, model 2.0.0.

Publishes SIMATIC v1 bulk payloads like an S7 connector named "tirepress1" with connection "factory":
  metadata  ie/m/j/simatic/v1/tirepress1/dp (retained)
  data      ie/d/j/simatic/v1/tirepress1/dp/r/factory/{Press_0,Cycle_0,Anomaly_0,Command_0} every 500 ms
  writes    ie/d/j/simatic/v1/tirepress1/dp/w/factory/{Command_0,AI_0}  payload {"seq":1,"vals":[{"id":"<tag id>","val":<value>}]}

After importing: open the broker node "ie-databus" and enter a Databus user that may publish and subscribe to ie/#.
Give the flow persistent context if counters should survive a restart. One flow instance per connector name.

Anomalies: one random anomaly at a time (mean gap Cmd.Anomaly.MeanIntervalMin, default 10 min, lasting 2-7 min).
Ground truth is on the Anomaly_0 chunk; keep those tags out of detector inputs and use them to score detections.
AI Inference Server may write TCP01.AI.* on ie/d/j/simatic/v1/tirepress1/dp/w/factory/AI_0; the flow echoes them to ie/d/j/simatic/v1/tirepress1/dp/r/factory/AI_0.

Rebuild with: node flow/build-flow.mjs --connector tirepress1 --connection factory
